name: reset-password-01
title: Reset password 01
description: Choose a new password twice, with the rules as a checklist that ticks itself off while you type, then a card that says it is done. Stubby writes it down. Taped card on the desk with a pencil and push-pins.
docs:
Installed the "Reset password 01" block into your components directory under blocks/reset-password-01/.
Import it: import ResetPassword01Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/reset-password-01/page"
Needs vee-validate@^5, vee-validate@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
